# Overview

This directory contains .Rmd scripts to analyze .fcs and Cq values, with corresponding .html output files.

# Inputs

* `2026-05-12_SUN4_UTR_flow` takes as input .fcs files in "SUN4_UTR_flow" (see input > FCS)
* `2026-05-11_Ssd1_pointmutant_flow` takes .fcs files in "Ssd1_pointmutants_flow" (see input > FCS)
* `2026-05-12_SUN4wholeUTRs_RTqPCR` takes Ct values in "wholeUTRs_Ct" (see input > RTqPCR_Ct)
* `2026-05-12_SUN4_5UTRmuts_RTqPCR` takes Ct values in "5UTRmuts_Ct" (see input > RTqPCR_Ct)

These scripts are used to generate all flow cytometry ridgeplots and RT-qPCR dotplots (update this)
